title: A marketplace's catalogue.json: the apps it offers (framework packaging §2).

folder.description: the app's folder in the repository: a relative path with no `..`, `.` or empty segment

preview.description: image URL; defaults to <folder>/thumbnail.png on the same ref

toolkit.description: requirement: the toolkit the app is built on; compatible when it is installed here

agentAppVersion.description: requirement: a string is the framework version the package is written for, compatible on the same major (and for 0.x the same minor); a number is CraftBot's Living UI format, never compatible

livingUIVersion.description: marks a CraftBot Living UI app: never installable as is (packaging §7)
